_about: Names and terms for the en/ja/ko/es/pt/id/vi/th dubs of 種田娶妻打天下 (dub.<locale>.json next to each episode's video.json). Names follow the Mandarin reading in every locale but vi, which uses the Sino-Vietnamese (Hán-Việt) reading as Vietnamese dubs of Chinese dramas do. lead is the voice instruction that replaces the zh-TW accent wording; persona is each character's manner in English (the zh-TW style without its accent clause), kept the same for every locale. A line's emotion is passed through as written in Chinese, marked as direction only.

lead.en: Speak natural, fluent American English as a native-speaking voice actor in an animated drama dub; no foreign accent, natural rhythm and contractions.
lead.ja: Speak natural standard Japanese (Tokyo) as a native Japanese anime voice actor; no foreign accent, natural Japanese rhythm and intonation.
lead.ko: Speak natural standard Seoul Korean as a native Korean voice actor in an animated drama dub; no foreign accent, natural Korean rhythm and intonation.
lead.es: Speak natural, neutral Latin American Spanish (Mexican standard) as a native-speaking voice actor in an animated drama dub; no foreign accent, natural rhythm and intonation.
lead.pt: Speak natural Brazilian Portuguese (São Paulo standard) as a native-speaking Brazilian voice actor in an animated drama dub; no foreign accent, natural rhythm and intonation.
lead.id: Speak natural, standard Indonesian (Jakarta, conversational, not stiff or formal) as a native Indonesian voice actor in an animated drama dub; no foreign accent, natural rhythm and intonation.
lead.vi: Speak natural standard Northern Vietnamese (Hanoi) as a native Vietnamese voice actor dubbing a Chinese costume drama; no foreign accent, clear tones, natural rhythm.
lead.th: Speak natural standard Central Thai (Bangkok) as a native Thai voice actor dubbing a Chinese costume drama; no foreign accent, clear tones, natural rhythm and polite particles only where written.

xuyan.th: สวี่เยี่ยน
xuyan.persona: A 25-year-old modern young man: relaxed, quick with a wry joke, steady and calm when he gets serious.

xitong.persona: A low, even, emotionless synthesized electronic voice, like an airport announcement or a system prompt, word by word, now and then coldly sarcastic.

mianshiguan.th: ผู้สัมภาษณ์
mianshiguan.persona: A 30-year-old HR manager: cold, impatient, does not even look up.

erniu.ja: アーニウ（ワン・アーニウ）
erniu.th: เอ้อร์หนิว (หวังเอ้อร์หนิว)
erniu.persona: A 24-year-old big, simple-hearted guy: loud voice, laughs a lot, goofy and warm.

xiaohe.persona: An 8-year-old little girl: soft, babyish, sweet-talking.

zhaobutou.th: มือปราบจ้าว
zhaobutou.persona: A 40-year-old constable: by-the-book, impatient, looks down his nose at people.

qinshuang.persona: A 21-year-old young woman: bold, crisp and blunt, a bright mid-high clear female voice with a hint of a scornful smile.

aling.persona: A 20-year-old cool, aloof girl: light, soft, a little breathy, pitched high but flat, few words, short sentences, cold as ice yet a little fragile.

tangxiaotang.th: ถังเสี่ยวถัง
tangxiaotang.persona: An 18-year-old rich young lady: sweet voice, talks fast, turns razor-sharp the moment money is counted.

qianyuanwai.th: เศรษฐีเฉียน
qianyuanwai.persona: A 50-year-old country landlord: oily, sneering, drawls his words.

laisan.persona: A 28-year-old household servant: glib, smooth-talking, guilty and nervous underneath.

sunzhanggui.th: เถ้าแก่ซุน
sunzhanggui.persona: A 45-year-old trading-house manager: all smiles, slow and deliberate, a knife hidden in every word.

zongbiaotou.th: หัวหน้าสำนักคุ้มภัย
zongbiaotou.persona: A 45-year-old head of an escort agency: loud, hearty, straight-talking.

menfang.th: คนเฝ้าประตู
menfang.persona: A 50-year-old gatekeeper of the Qian house: snide, sneering, bullying on his master's behalf.

huxianling.th: นายอำเภอหู
huxianling.persona: A 48-year-old corrupt county magistrate: pompous official tone, drawn-out words, fake gravitas.

shimujiang.th: ช่างไม้สือ
shimujiang.persona: A 55-year-old old carpenter, male: rough, hoarse and low, stubborn, short sentences, impatient.

hanbo.persona: A 65-year-old old village head, male: aged, gentle but weighty, speaks slowly, every sentence certain.

weishaoqing.th: เว่ยเส้าชิง
weishaoqing.persona: The prime minister's spoiled son from the capital: handsome, languid and arrogant, speaks with a lazy, mocking smile.

weijihuoji.en: the Wei and Co. shop boy
weijihuoji.es: el mozo de la casa Wei
weijihuoji.th: เด็กร้านเว่ยจี้
weijihuoji.persona: A skinny, loud young shop boy hawking goods in the street: brash, cheeky, shouting to draw a crowd.

zhengbo.persona: A 60-year-old head steward of the Tang family, male: warm, steady and courteous; when he lowers his voice it carries worry.

tangwanjin.th: ถังว่านจิน
tangwanjin.persona: A rich 50-year-old merchant, male: genial and money-minded; theatrical only when pleading poverty.

jieshangfuren.th: หญิงชาวบ้านบนถนน
jieshangfuren.persona: A 40-year-old townswoman, female: shrill voice that jumps to a scream when frightened.

diaoqi.persona: A 35-year-old bandit chief: rough, hoarse, menacing, short clipped sentences, no warmth.

baidaifu.persona: A 68-year-old old physician: thin dry voice, slow and clear, every word sure, kind underneath.

duizhang.th: หัวหน้าทหารยาม
duizhang.persona: A 40-year-old gate captain: barking, officious, used to being obeyed.

shoujun.th: ทหารยามหนุ่ม

fengshui.th: ซินแสฮวงจุ้ย
fengshui.persona: A 45-year-old wandering geomancer: thin reedy male voice, drawn-out and theatrical, mock-solemn, startles easily.

xudalang.th: สวี่ต้าหลาง
xudalang.persona: A 29-year-old scholar, Xu Yan's elder clan cousin, male: warm, chatty and eager to please, always speaking through a friendly smile.

zhouyuanwai.persona: A 50-year-old rich man of the prefectural city, male, a low voice: snobbish and sour, drawling slowly, enjoying every barb.

zhanggui.th: เถ้าแก่โรงเตี๊ยม
zhanggui.persona: A 45-year-old innkeeper, male: slick and loud when quoting a price, flustered and fawning once caught.

shuli.th: เสมียนสนามสอบ
shuli.persona: A 35-year-old examination registrar, male: flat, bored, bureaucratic, never looking up.

chengshanzhang.th: อาจารย์ใหญ่เฉิง
chengshanzhang.persona: A 60-year-old headmaster of the prefectural academy, male: refined and warm, slow and weighty; his questions get sharper one by one.

fengxuezheng.th: ผู้คุมสอบเฝิง
fengxuezheng.persona: A 52-year-old provincial examiner, male: dry, sharp and officious; clears his throat before he speaks and drawls when he sneers.

weixun.persona: A 23-year-old young master of the Wei clan, male: clear, arrogant and contemptuous; his voice tightens when he panics.

dutie.persona: A 58-year-old army veteran of the Qin army, male: rough, hoarse and loud; his voice shakes when he speaks of his old general.

chuzhifu.th: เจ้าเมืองฉู่
chuzhifu.persona: A 50-year-old prefect, male: calm, low and measured, authority without raising his voice; when he lowers it every word is a calculation.

dengyasi.th: นายกองเติ้ง
dengyasi.persona: A 40-year-old thug leader posing as a prisoner escort, male: heavy, gloomy and menacing, short clipped sentences.

lengtie.th: เหลิงเถี่ย
lengtie.persona: A 38-year-old assassin leader, male: in his eunuch disguise a put-on thin, mannered voice; once unmasked, ice-cold and low, every word bitten off.

changgonggong.persona: A 60-year-old palace eunuch, male: aged, soft and kindly; tearful when he is moved.

xunkao.th: ผู้คุมห้องสอบ
xunkao.persona: A 40-year-old examination proctor, male: curt, bored, rule-bound.

xunbing.th: ทหารลาดตระเวน
xunbing.persona: A 30-year-old patrol soldier, male: suspicious and gruff, easily brushed off.

yayi.th: เจ้าหน้าที่ที่ว่าการ
yayi.persona: A 30-year-old yamen runner, male: loud and officious, barking orders.

baobang.th: ผู้ประกาศผลสอบ
baobang.persona: A 40-year-old results herald, male: booming and sing-song, stretching every name.

weiguanjia.th: พ่อบ้านตระกูลเว่ย
weiguanjia.persona: A 50-year-old steward of the Wei family, male: low, smooth and condescending, never raising his voice.

tongpan.th: รองเจ้าเมือง
tongpan.persona: A 45-year-old vice-prefect in the Wei family's pocket, male: haughty and dismissive, turning nasty when pressed.

zhifufuren.th: ภริยาเจ้าเมือง
zhifufuren.persona: A 45-year-old prefect's wife, female: gracious and composed, a little shrewd, warming once won over.

xinchai.persona: A 25-year-old courier, male: breathless and urgent, words tumbling out.

shaonian.th: เด็กหนุ่มยามเฝ้า
shaonian.persona: A 15-year-old village lookout, male: a cracking young voice, shouting in alarm.

jinjuntongling.th: ผู้บัญชาการทหารองครักษ์
jinjuntongling.persona: A 45-year-old commander of the imperial guard, male: deep, clipped and military.
